lede: Springfield celebrates Christmas with a lighted downtown parade, a month of lights at J. Travis Price Park and a farm visit with Santa and the Standardbreds.
celebrates: The City of Springfield lights its holiday season with Winter Wonderland at J. Travis Price Park, now in its 26th year, with thousands of lights and more than a dozen festive scenes from November 28 to December 27. On the walk-through Saturdays, December 5, 12 and 19, families can visit Santa in the cabin, ride ponies, pet the animals and warm up at fire pits. The city's night-time Christmas parade rolls on Saturday, December 5, at 5:30 pm from 10th Avenue and South Main Street. A foster farm also hosts Christmas on the Farm with Santa and the Standardbreds.
lastyear: The City of Springfield describes its Winter Wonderland as the 26th annual in 2026, which puts the first display back around the turn of the century. The city's page says the park is closed to the public while the display is set up, and that drive-through viewing runs on most nights with walk-through nights on three Saturdays. The city's parade page says the night-time Christmas parade begins at the intersection of 10th Avenue and South Main Street, and the same parade date opens the first walk-through night at the park.
facts: Springfield is the Robertson County seat, north of Nashville near the Kentucky line. J. Travis Price Park is at 4155 Wilks Road, and the park is closed to the public during setup before the display opens. Winter Wonderland is closed on December 24 and 25. Food trucks sell food and drinks each Saturday, and activities such as pony rides, the petting zoo and inflatables are on the walk-through nights only. The parade on December 5 shares its date with the first walk-through Saturday, so families can plan both in one evening.
trains: The nearest train ride for families is run by the Tennessee Central Railway Museum in Nashville. Its page on this site lists Saturday excursions to Watertown and Lebanon and the December Santa Express, which is the best fit for a child who wants a real holiday train. Ticket details are on the museum's page. For a station stop closer to home, check each event listing, since none of the events on this page involve a train ride. Plan on driving to the Nashville area for the Santa Express and book early.

faq: When is Winter Wonderland in Springfield in 2026?

Winter Wonderland at J. Travis Price Park, 4155 Wilks Road, is open November 28 through December 27, 2026, from 5:30 to 9 pm, except December 24 and 25. It is free. Walk-through nights are Saturdays, December 5, 12 and 19, and the other nights are drive-through viewing.
When is the Springfield Christmas Parade in 2026?

The City of Springfield's annual night-time Christmas parade is on Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 5:30 pm. It begins at 10th Avenue and South Main Street and is free to watch. The first walk-through night at Winter Wonderland is the same evening, from 5:30 to 9 pm.

Yes. Santa is in the cabin at Winter Wonderland on the walk-through Saturdays, December 5, 12 and 19. Santa and the Standardbreds, a farm event at a foster sanctuary, is also listed on this page on Saturday, November 28, from noon to 4 pm for $20 per family, with the address sent after booking.
What is on the walk-through nights at Winter Wonderland?

The city lists the candy cane trail, visits with Santa in the cabin, fire pits, carriage rides, character visits, a petting zoo, pony rides and inflatables. Food trucks sell food and drinks each Saturday. Drive-through nights are for viewing the lights from your car.

The Christmas Parade and Winter Wonderland are both free. Food, carriage rides and some Saturday extras may cost extra, so check the city's page. The Christmas on the Farm with Santa and the Standardbreds event is $20 per family and is a separate booking.
